simulation.why: Demonstration scheduling, incident severity and sampling choices; none are Partec production facts. Production spread interprets published ranges as +/- 2 sigma; the Ni incident is an illustrative rule, not a calibrated chemistry model.

barrel_load_kg.why: no public barrel capacity found; sets pieces per barrel

thread_area_factor.why: threads add surface; geometric cylinder underestimates it

aim_thickness.value: midpoint of a closed range, minimum + 3 um if open ended
aim_thickness.why: plating to the minimum risks rejects

within_carrier_cv.why: spread of thickness between pieces of one barrel; not published

analyses_per_day.why: typical once per shift or day; not published

ni_check_every_nth_lot.why: deposit Ni is often sampled, not checked on every lot; creates the gap the planted complaint uses

rectifier_noise.why: relative noise on simulated rectifier readings

rectifier_fault_factor.why: planted fault: one slot delivers 70 % current for one day

incidents.why: planted on purpose so the trace queries have something to find
